reference.read_method: spec from current filesystem; both photo JSONs read from HEAD blobs because sparse worktree omitted them. No reference production files changed.
reference.inspection_scope: Read full spec and photo-plan/sequence metadata; sampled two native final-film frames and12 native sequence frames (sequence01 and10), measured motion/transition on actual sequence10. Not a full-film audio/music audit.

native_examples.observed: Actual HD final-film photographer photo fills1080×950 at y250–1200; date/chapter above, captions/footer below; no blur padding.
Actual HD final-film match picture fills1080×980 at y230–1210; fixed center1190×1080 source window, real scoreboard restored at y1064; no old1080×608 narrow match banner.

arc: 10.35s current trophy-winning cold open with original commentary, full champion point replayed later
Historical trajectory explained through photo/card narration, separated by real trophy lifts
Native stats cards define statistical scope; retreat/withdrawal is explained rather than erased
For current rounds: photo or card sets concrete stakes, then a complete selected point plus original commentary/English-Chinese subtitles
Finale: narrated setup → long complete point → real trophy video → closing question/brand outro
structure.transfer_principle: Borrow the grammar and geometry, not the6min30 length or Alcaraz-specific number of match clips.

visual_language.palette: deep navy, one lime accent, white/gray type; no blurred-background padding

photo_area.fit: cover with explicit subject focus; default in reference0.5,0.4

match_area.crop: fixed center source1190×1080, contain_keep0.62 for1920×1080 sources
match_area.scoreboard: same-frame original board placed leftbottom at y1064, not recreated figures

visual_language.captions: below picture, aroundy1284; date/chapter rail above photo; footer aroundy1385

photo_movement.interpretation: subtle centered push (~1.07% enlargement over7.3s), no sweeping camera move or face tracking

transitions.method: native25fps photo-area RGB blend fit; alpha≈0.136 at9.38,0.558 at9.50,0.985 at9.62
transitions.interpretation: short soft dissolves, preserve quiet photo motion and narrated continuity

visual_language.page_rhythm: 2–3 shots per narrated segment, usually5–10s per shot; photos trade places with native cards. Timing in plan is a budget, not permission to hold silence.

recommendation.main_line: 上海第一冠让他走上更高一级的赛场；接下来一年有高点、伤停、复出、早退与再回升，巴塞尔第二冠是这一年的收束。
recommendation.priority: 新片全年起伏是主体；巴塞尔只作简明路程＋完整冠军点＋真实捧杯。不要沿用旧Basel五轮逐场长复盘的结构。
recommendation.duration_target: 约4–4分半，以上270.3s为预算，真实TTS/完整原声决定最终长度，不为了凑4分半停空页。

blocks.content: 网球时差·网球有故事统一片尾

simplification: 去年上海只保留一次成功的坐标，不复述资格赛每一轮或2024前情。
巴黎/澳网/蒙卡用三站合段，不给每站完整赛点和逐盘比分。
伤停—7月格施塔德复出单独形成转折；东京明确叫后续回升。
成都首战失利和上海卫冕出局都保留，但各一两句；它们解释一年不是连续向上。
巴塞尔前四轮优先照片/事实卡合计约25s，不因已有视频就全部塞入。
决赛只用14s交代三盘走向；省出的时间给一整年。
原声主要放在当下短冷开场、最终完整冠军点和捧杯现场声。若补本人采访，只选一句同年同场已核原声，并从照片旁白预算中置换时间。
implementation_notes: 沿用参考HD画布和图片区位置，照片缓推约1–2%/8–10s，切换约0.28s软溶解；不新增花哨运镜。
同站2–3张摄影照片与一张事实卡交替；每张照片可追溯年份/赛事/人物/来源。
官方摄影缺口用native chronology/score card说明，不能拿视频截图伪称摄影。
照片/字卡的具体切换点跟真实配音词边界，不能机械每6秒一页。
照片区1080×950，比赛区1080×980；字幕与品牌各有固定空间。
参考示例是389.8s，不因“模仿阿卡”就复制它的时长或26个段落。
